recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抹片出現一大團以藍色纖維狀細胞質細胞堆成的結節，幾乎沒有造血細胞；高倍可見細胞質如揉皺紙巾（crumpled tissue paper）、核小而偏位的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell），符合骨髓高雪氏瘤（Gaucheroma）。
features: Low power: large cohesive aggregate composed almost entirely of histiocytes with blue fibrillary cytoplasm, with very few hematopoietic cells
Very large histiocytes with low N:C ratio and small, eccentric, round nuclei with condensed chromatin
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with striated, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' texture (typical Gaucher cells, a)
Some Gaucher cells with less striated, more finely granular or vacuolated cytoplasm (less typical forms, b)
Scattered red cells and occasional small hematopoietic cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a large particle-like aggregate composed almost exclusively of large histiocytes with pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm, forming a pseudotumoral cluster with minimal residual hematopoiesis. At high power, the histiocytes have small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a striated, crumpled tissue paper appearance; some cells show less typical, more finely granular cytoplasm. No blasts or atypical epithelial cells are identified. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells forming a bone marrow Gaucheroma in a patient with known type 1 Gaucher disease.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (e.g., CML, myeloma, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look similar but occur in the setting of a separate neoplasm or infection with normal glucocerebrosidase activity; enzyme assay/GBA genotyping and the background marrow separate them.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, uniformly vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules of ceroid rather than a wrinkled striated cytoplasm.
Carcinoma clumps are cohesive cells with high N:C ratio, nuclear atypia and nucleoli, unlike these bland small-nucleated histiocytes.
